???- example "Example Code"

    ```lua
    local level = Game():GetLevel()
    local curRoom = level:GetCurrentRoomDesc()
    if curRoom.GridIndex == GridRooms.ROOM_ERROR_IDX then
      print("Success")
    end
    ```
